subject: ACME POC kickoff - aligning calendars and owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.j@acme.com>, Ben Patel <ben.p@acme.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME POC kickoff - scheduling and owners

Hi Alice / Ben —

Excited to get the POC kickoff on the calendar. Per our discovery, the kickoff will be a 60–75 minute session to cover success criteria, timeline, owners, and initial environment needs. Proposed agenda: 

- Introductions & objectives (5–10m)
- Success criteria and scope (10–15m)
- Technical plan: infra, access, and data flows (20–25m)
- Timeline & milestones (10m)
- Action items / next steps (5–10m)

Proposed dates/times (all PT):
- Thu Mar 25, 10:00–11:15 AM
- Fri Mar 26, 9:00–10:15 AM
- Mon Mar 29, 1:00–2:15 PM

Attendees we recommend:
- Marissa Cole (AE) — Redwood (me)
- Dylan Brooks (SE) — Redwood
- Alice Johnson — ACME (Eng lead)
- Ben Patel — ACME (Procurement)
- Security and infra reps from ACME (please CC)

Can you confirm which of those slots work for your team and who from security/procurement should join? I attached the POC plan (ACME_POC_PLAN_v1.pdf) and a short checklist.

If it's easier, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min — feel free to pick a slot and I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in and the kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.co[email]
[attachment: ACME_POC_PLAN_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alice Johnson <alice.j@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, security@acme.com
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME POC kickoff - scheduling and owners

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the agenda. Friday the 26th morning looks tight for us; Mar 25 at 10am PT should work for the engineering team.

A few quick notes:
- Please include a technical checklist in the invite so our infra team knows what access to expect.
- Procurement (procurement@acme.com) will need an outline of timelines and the procurement path — they usually need a 10 business day window for any contract/SOW reviews.
- Security (security@acme.com) asked to see the SOC2 questionnaire in advance if possible.

Attendees confirmed from our side: myself (Alice), Ben Patel (procurement), + one security engineer (I'll loop in specifically once I confirm availability).

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Alice
Alice Johnson
Engineering Manager, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.j@acme.com>, Ben Patel <ben.p@acme.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME POC kickoff - scheduling and owners

Great — thanks Alice.

Locking in Thu Mar 25, 10:00–11:15 AM PT unless I hear otherwise by EOD tomorrow.

Quick follow-ups / what we'll provide before kickoff:
- Updated POC plan (short doc) with timeline & milestones — attached.
- SOC2 questionnaire and data handling notes — attaching the questionnaire (acme-soc2-questionnaire.pdf).
- Technical checklist for infra access (Dylan will add to the calendar invite).

Success criteria draft (please review / edit):
1) Redwood serving runtime ingest + respond to sample production traffic (10–50 qps) in ACME dev environment.
2) Latency under 300ms p95 for targeted endpoints during 1k token prompts.
3) Integration smoke test with ACME auth and logging pipeline.
4) Agreed rollout timeline and owner sign-offs for next steps.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood AE: Marissa — overall program lead
- Redwood SE: Dylan — technical lead for setup & smoke tests
- ACME Eng: Alice — product/eng owner
- ACME Procurement: Ben — procurement & contract path
- ACME Security: (TBD) — compliance & data controls

If this looks good I'll send the invite and include the docs + a short dial-in agenda.

Marissa
[attachment: acme-soc2-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Johnson <alice.j@acme.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME POC kickoff - scheduling and owners

On Thu, Mar 19, 2026 at 08:30 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Locking in Thu Mar 25, 10:00–11:15 AM PT unless I hear otherwise by EOD tomorrow.

I'll be there to run the technical portion. A couple of items I need from ACME before we start:
- Temporary dev credentials (or a short-lived service account) to validate integration and KV cache paths.
- Sample payloads (anonymized) or a small dataset to replicate expected token distributions.
- Network expectations: will we be hitting a private VPC endpoint or using a public endpoint? If VPC, we'll need IP allowlist entries (I can provide IP ranges).

I've attached the onboarding checklist to the calendar invite draft (redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf). If procurement needs SOW language, ask Ben to reference the short SOW appendix in the POC plan.

Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alice Johnson <alice.j@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Patel <ben.p@acme.com>, security@acme.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME POC kickoff - aligning calendars and owners

Thanks everyone — Mar 25 at 10:00 AM PT is confirmed for the kickoff. I've added our security engineer (Raj Singh) to the thread; he will join the kickoff.

Confirmed success criteria and owners (final):
- SC1: Redwood runtime returns expected responses for our sample dataset at 10–50 qps — owner: Dylan / ACME Eng (Alice)
- SC2: p95 latency < 300ms on target endpoints — owner: Dylan / Redwood perf team
- SC3: Integration logs sent to our ELK pipeline and basic auth validated — owner: ACME Eng (Alice)
- SC4: Procurement receives SOW + contract timeline — owner: Ben Patel

Action items before kickoff:
- ACME to send anonymized sample payloads and confirmation on network path (VPC vs public) — owner: Alice (by Tue Mar 23 EOD)
- Redwood to send final invite with dial-in, attachments, and an explicit checklist for access — owner: Marissa (sent)
- Redwood SE to provide IP ranges and onboarding steps — owner: Dylan (in calendar invite)

Ben — can procurement confirm the expected review window so we can align the POC timeline?

See you Thursday.

Alice Johnson
Engineering Manager, Acme Corp
[calendar invite: Thu Mar 25 10:00 AM PT — ACME POC Kickoff]
